description:
Memorial list of the ancestors of a well-known judge, the late Shemuʾel b. Saʿadya ha-Levi. Headed "the Levite family." Starting with Yiṣḥaq ha-Sar; his son Yaʿaqov ha-Rav ha-Muvhaq ha-Patish ha-Ḥazaq; his son Yiṣḥaq ha-Rofeʾ Tifʾeret ha-Rofʾim; his son Saʿadya; (continuing on verso) his son Shemuʾel ha-Rav ha-Muvhaq ha-Paṭish ha-Ḥazaq ha-Muflaʾ ha-Mumḥe "who judged Israel for 45 years in accordance with religion and law" the judge Nezer ha-Maskilim. Cf. Yevr. II B 1535 (PGPID 41769).

There are also remnants of accounts in Greek/Coptic numerals probably from an earlier document on verso.
description_he: רשימת יזכור למשפחת הלוי, פותחת ביצחק השר וממשיכה לבנו יעקב וכן הלאה.
